Living parasitic aberration. The voremind subtype marks the same species. Not undead.

The Voremind

The Voremind are not creatures of death. They are life stripped of individuality, a biological consciousness that views all living things as incomplete pieces of itself.

Unlike the undead, the Voremind do not raise corpses through necromancy. They consume and reconstruct organic material, weaving living tissue into entirely new organisms.

Their most terrifying trait is that they keep the memories of the creatures they assimilate. As their numbers grow, so does their collective intelligence.

Ancient scholars of the Grand Archive called the outbreak the Carrion Bloom. They believed they were containing a disease. What they actually imprisoned was an intelligent species.

Every Voremind creature is a living aberration, not undead. Positive energy heals it. Negative energy harms it. Undead-only effects, including channel energy against undead, do not treat it as undead. It is immune to Assimilating Blight and not immune to other diseases. It can be critically hit, sneaked, poisoned, and affected by mind-affecting effects unless a statblock says otherwise.

Assimilating Blight is an extraordinary biological disease. Injury or inhaled, as the attack says. Onset 1 round, frequency 1/round for 6 rounds, 1d2 Constitution and 1d2 Wisdom damage, sickened for 1 round on a failed save, cure 2 consecutive saves. A creature that dies infected, or whose Constitution or Wisdom reaches 0 from the disease, becomes one of the Reclaimed after 1d4 rounds if the body is intact. Remove disease or heal ends the blight before that change. After the change, the creature is a new aberration.
It speaks to Voremind within 1 mile, directs them, and uses their senses. The ordinary 300-foot synaptic communion still connects the rest of the colony.

Mind-rending pulse. Once every 1d4 rounds, 60-foot-radius burst, 10d6 untyped psychic damage, Will DC 25 half. Failure also confuses the creature for 1d4 rounds. Mind-affecting.

Memory absorption. One minute of contact with a helpless living creature or an intact corpse. It learns memories, languages, and ordinary knowledge. It does not gain class features, spells, or special abilities.

Spell-like abilities. Caster level 14, concentration +18. At will: detect thoughts (DC 16), telekinesis (DC 19). 3/day: dominate person (DC 19), mind fog (DC 19). 1/day: dominate monster (DC 23).

Living Reconstruction. Fast healing 15, suppressed until the end of its next turn after fire or acid.
Once every 1d4 rounds. 60-foot burst. Mind-affecting. No energy type.

A fused pile of hosts with a shared mind. Faces surface in the flesh and speak in pieces.

Broodmind — CR 14, XP 38,400.

Conduct

It stays in the hive. Telepathy, domination, and the lesser Voremind keep anyone from reaching the central mass.
